monitor.metric: sum of proc_taskinfo pti_resident_size for root and recursively observed descendants
monitor.missing_root_policy: bounded wait confirms and reaps exit before normal completion; otherwise monitoring failure

termination.fallback: direct child kill after a bounded wait
termination.permission_and_other_errors: record structurally; never wait indefinitely; campaign treats cleanup errors as infrastructure failure

failure_policy.hash_or_identity_mismatch: stop before the affected solver call
failure_policy.genuine_launch_monitor_or_cleanup_failur: preserve logs and call record; stop campaign; mark remaining calls unrun
failure_policy.timeout_memory_cutoff_unknown_or_solver_: mark unresolved and continue fixed schedule
failure_policy.partition_sat: require preserved solver witness output; stop that logical slot and mark later cells unrun
